But this is a weak case, and I'd recommend skipping. The first two minutes after graduation show about 3,000 SOL bought by 24 wallets, with the top five buyers taking 99.9% of volume and a launch bot present. That is the operator pattern, and the buy-side depth is almost certainly operator-funded rather than organic demand. Recent operator-backed coins have been roughly break-even, before our 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost, so the expected value is negative. A skipped coin costs nothing; I'd pass.
